name: Side Plank Rotation
steps: Hold a forearm side plank with your elbow directly under your shoulder, hips elevated, and top arm reaching straight toward the ceiling.
Brace your core and sweep your top arm slowly under your torso while rotating your upper chest toward the floor.
Reverse smoothly to open your chest back to the side and reach your top arm straight overhead again.
Keep your hips lifted throughout every repetition, then switch sides after finishing one side.
tips: Rotate primarily through your upper back and waist while keeping your hips steady and high.
Stagger your top foot slightly in front of your bottom foot if you need extra balance.
